watches.name: FLIEGER 45G AGGRESSOR SQUADRON
watches.description: The Australian built Panzera Flieger 45G Aggressor is a stunning limited edition timepiece only available to members of the USAF Aggressor Squadron. Emboldened with the Aggressor logo on the dial, it combines classic style and heritage of vintage aviation with contemporary features including a GMT second 24 hour time zone, a rugged and reliable Japanese NH34A automatic movement that can be admired through the sapphire glass case back and 100m water resistance. It has a large and clear dial with luminous hands and markers that make it easy to read in any light condition. It also has a domed sapphire crystal that protects it from scratches and reflections. The watch comes with a choice of different straps that can be easily changed in seconds with its quick release mechanism. The Flieger 45G Aggressor automatic pilots watch has a matte black dial with 316L stainless steel case finished in either a brushed and polished silver.

watches.name: LONGREACH 43G-03
watches.description: Bold. Functional. Effortlessly Refined. The PANZERA LONGREACH 43G Black Dial with Two Tone Gold & Silver Case is a modern pilot’s watch engineered for global travellers who demand precision, versatility, and timeless design. Confidently sized at 43mm, this automatic timepiece pairs classic aviation aesthetics with contemporary GMT performance. The carbon black dial and bezel is framed by an elegant 316L stainless steel silver and 18 karat gold plated two tone case and protected by scratch-resistant sapphire crystal and bi-directional rotating ceramic bezel. Designed to perform across time zones and environments, the LONGREACH 43G transitions seamlessly from cockpit to boardroom. At its heart beats the reliable Seiko NH34 automatic GMT movement , enabling the display of three time zones simultaneously —local time, home time, and a third reference—making it the ideal companion for frequent flyers and international professionals. The movement provides smooth, dependable operation with a 41-hour power reserve and hacking seconds for precise setting. For clear visibility day or night, the hands, hour markers and ceramic GMT bezel are treated with SuperLuminova luminous coating. A screw-down crown enhances durability, while 100m water resistance enables you to take it swimming as well as ensures confidence for everyday wear and travel. Finished with a matching two tone gold and stainless steel bracelet or premium leather or rubber strap, the LONGREACH 43G delivers understated strength and refined pilot-watch character. Backed by a 2-year international warranty , it’s a timepiece built for those who move seamlessly between destinations—and expect their watch to do the same.

watches.name: AQUAMARINE 45D-01
watches.description: A Professional-Grade Dive Watch for Every Adventure The PANZERA Aquamarine 45D-01 (Black Dial) is a striking timepiece that blends precision engineering with bold, functional design. Built to perform in the harshest underwater environments, it offers 300 M / 30 ATM water resistance , a scratch-resistant sapphire crystal , and a rotating internal dive bezel —controlled by a dedicated screw-down crown—to accurately track elapsed dive time. At its heart beats the reliable Seiko NH35 automatic movement , renowned for its accuracy and durability. The oversized dial features crisp luminous hands and markers , ensuring perfect legibility whether you’re navigating sunlit shallows or the ocean depths. Above the surface, the Aquamarine 45D adapts effortlessly to your style with a wide range of quick-release rubber, metal, and genuine leather straps , allowing you to switch looks in seconds—no tools required. Equally at home on the wrist of a seasoned diver or an everyday explorer , the Aquamarine 45D is the ultimate companion from ocean to city.

watches.name: AQUAMARINE 45
watches.description: The AQUAMARINE 45 offers a stunning array of dial options, including matte black, midnight blue, ice white, and emerald green. These striking dials are paired with a solid 316L stainless steel case, available in polished silver, polished IP gold, or matte IP black finishes. The watch is engineered for durability, featuring a knurled screw-down crown, sapphire crystal with anti-reflective coating, and an impressive 200m water resistance. The hands and indexes are treated with Super-LumiNova coating, ensuring optimal visibility in low light and nighttime conditions. watches.name: AQUAMARINE 36
watches.description: Crafted in Australia, the PANZERA Aquamarine 36 women's watch collection exudes elegance and durability, offering a stunning array of dial colors including light blue, dark blue, pastel pink, white, and matte black. Each dial, with the exception of matte black, showcases a mesmerizing textured and reflective Mother of Pearl finish, encased within a robust 100m water-resistant solid stainless steel case. The case features a sophisticated blend of polished and brushed finishes, available in both silver and gold tones. Adding a touch of luxury, the watch is adorned with radiant Swarovski crystals on the dial and bezel, complemented by a screw-down crown, sapphire scratch-resistant glass with an anti-reflective coating, and impressive 100m water resistance. At its heart, the Aquamarine 36 is powered by a highly precise Swiss Ronda 515 Quartz movement, featuring a date function and boasting a 3-year battery life. For enhanced visibility in low light and nighttime settings, the hands and indexes are coated with Super-LumiNova. The Aquamarine 36 offers versatility in style with two strap options. Choose the solid link 316L stainless steel strap with a brushed and polished finish, secured by an integrated push-button deployment clasp. Alternatively, opt for a luxurious hand-stitched genuine leather strap available in various colors, secured by a pin-buckle clasp color-matched to the case. All PANZERA straps are equipped with a quick-release mechanism, allowing you to effortlessly swap straps in seconds, without the need for tools.
